input.sql: SELECT p.plant_name, SUM(f.units_scrapped) AS scrapped, SUM(f.units_produced) AS produced, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(f.units_scrapped) / NULLIF(SUM(f.units_produced), 0), 2) AS scrap_rate_pct FROM analytics.fact_production f JOIN analytics.dim_plant p ON p.plant_id = f.plant_id WHERE f.produced_at >= TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE '2026-11-10 00:00:00-06' AND f.produced_at < TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE '2026-11-17 00:00:00-06' GROUP BY p.plant_name ORDER BY scrap_rate_pct DESC NULLS LAST

question: Compare scrap rate by plant for the 7 complete days before today.
answer: Fresno had the highest scrap rate over the 7 complete days from Monday 9 November to Sunday 15 November 2026 (Chicago time), at 3.4% (10,167 of 298,791 cases). Columbus was at 1.74% and Dallas was lowest at 1.22%. Scrap rate here is cases scrapped divided by cases produced.

input.sql:
SELECT p.plant_name,
       SUM(f.units_produced) AS units_produced,
       SUM(f.units_scrapped) AS units_scrapped,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(f.units_scrapped) / NULLIF(SUM(f.units_produced), 0), 2) AS scrap_rate_pct
FROM analytics.fact_production f
JOIN analytics.dim_plant p ON p.plant_id = f.plant_id
WHERE f.produced_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-09 00:00:00' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'
  AND f.produced_at <  TIMESTAMP '2026-11-16 00:00:00' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'
GROUP BY p.plant_name
ORDER BY scrap_rate_pct DESC;
